items.quote: And Pharaoh's servants said unto him, How long shall this man be a snare unto us? let the men go, that they may serve the LORD their God
items.claim: Pharaoh's servants petitioned Pharaoh to release the Hebrew people to serve the LORD

items.quote: knowest thou not yet that Egypt is destroyed?
items.claim: Pharaoh's servants asserted that Egypt had been destroyed

items.quote: And Moses and Aaron were brought again unto Pharaoh
items.claim: Moses and Aaron were brought before Pharaoh

items.quote: and he said unto them, Go, serve the LORD your God
items.claim: Pharaoh commanded Moses and Aaron to go serve the LORD their God

items.quote: but who are they that shall go?
items.claim: Pharaoh questioned which people would participate in the departure

items.quote: And Moses said, We will go with our young and with our old, with our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds will we go
items.claim: Moses stated that all members of the community across all ages and all livestock would depart

items.quote: for we must hold a feast unto the LORD
items.claim: Moses asserted that the community must hold a religious feast to the LORD
